titleEn: The Glory of Kings — Israel Murmurs: the Censers and Aaron's Rod (ch. 97)
part: ch. 97 — Israel Murmurs: the Censers and Aaron's Rod
about: Israel murmurs again, claiming a share in the priesthood. Moses lets them try: seventy censers are made and carried into the Holy of Holies, and fire consumes the offerers. God has the censers hallowed (read as Mary, Christ and his fragrance), the earth swallows Dathan, Abiram and their households, and a plague takes their followers. Moses and Aaron make atonement, and God commands the writing of the rods that will show Aaron's (Numbers 16-17).

sentences.t: ፺፯ ፡ ኀበ ፡ አንጐርጐሩ ፡ እስራኤል ።
sentences.l: 97. Where they-murmured Israel.
sentences.i: Chapter 97: Where Israel Murmured
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ኀበ is 'where, in the place that', so the heading names the episode 'where Israel murmured' (a loose sense, ?). አንጐርጐሩ is the 3mp perfect of the four-letter verb አንጐርጐረ 'murmur, grumble'. The chapter retells Numbers 16-17 (the rebellion of Korah, Dathan and Abiram; the censers; Aaron's rod) with Kebra Nagast additions.

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ አንጐርጐሩ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ በእንተ ፡ ተክህኖ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብሉ ፡ ንሕነሰ ፡ አኮኑ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ንሕነ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ወእፎ ፡ ዘኢንሠውዕ ፡ ንሕነ ፡ ከማሆሙ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ስምዕ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ቅድስት ፡ በመዓጥንት ፡ ወበዕጣን ፡ ወበቅድሳት ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወአሮን ፡ እኁሁ ፡ ወደቂቆሙ ፡ ወንሕነሰ ፡ አኮኑ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ እለ ፡ ኀረየነ ፡ ከማሆሙ ፡ ወንገብር ፡ ፈቃዶ ፤
sentences.l: And-again they-murmured sons-of Israel concerning priesthood before God, while they-say: We-indeed, not-so Israel? We seed-of Abraham; and-how that-not-we-sacrifice, we like-them, in-midst-of tent-of testimony, at ark-of law-his of-God, Zion holy, with-censers and-with-incense and-with-holy-things, except Moses and-Aaron brother-his and-sons-their? And-we-indeed, not-so people who he-chose-us like-them, and-let-us-do will-his?
sentences.i: And again the children of Israel murmured about the priesthood before God, saying: 'Are we not Israel? We are the seed of Abraham. How is it that we do not sacrifice, as they do, in the tent of testimony, at the ark of the law of God, holy Zion, with censers and incense and holy things, and only Moses and his brother Aaron and their sons do? Are we not a people chosen like them? Let us do his will!'
sentences.n: Allusion: Numbers 16:1-3 (the claim that 'all the congregation are holy'). ወካዕበ 'and again'. ደቂቀ is the construct of ደቂቅ 'sons' (ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel'); በእንተ 'concerning'; ቅድመ 'before'. እንዘ ይብሉ 'while they say, saying' introduces the speech. -ሰ on ንሕነሰ means 'as for us, indeed'; አኮኑ 'is it not so?' marks a question expecting yes. ወእፎ 'and how (is it that)'; ዘኢንሠውዕ 'that we do not sacrifice' (ዘ- 'that' + ኢ- 'not' + 1pl imperfect of ሠውዐ). ከማሆሙ 'like them'. ታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the ark of his law, of God' (construct with the owner named after the suffix, as in ch. 1); ጽዮን ቅድስት 'holy Zion' stands in apposition: the Ark itself is Zion (the Zion theology of this book). በ- 'with, by means of' on መዓጥንት, ዕጣን, ቅድሳት; ዘእንበለ 'except, apart from'. እኁሁ 'his brother'. እለ ኀረየነ 'who chose us' is literally a relative clause with a resumptive 'us' and God as understood subject. ወንገብር is the 1pl jussive 'and let us do'. The long unit has no ፤ inside, so it is kept whole (45 words).

sentences.t: ወሰሚዖ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ይቤሎሙ ፡ ግበሩኬ ፡ ዘፈቀድክሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-having-heard Moses he-said-to-them: Do-then what you-desired.
sentences.i: When Moses heard this, he said to them: 'Then do what you desire.'
sentences.n: ወሰሚዖ is ወ- + ሰሚዖ, the gerund (converb) of ሰምዐ 'hear': 'and having heard' (subject Moses follows). ይቤሎሙ 'he said to them' (ይቤ + ለ- + ሙ). ግበሩኬ is the 2mp imperative of ገብረ 'do, make' + -ኬ 'then, so'. ዘፈቀድክሙ 'what you wished' (ዘ- + 2mp perfect of ፈቀደ 'desire, wish').

sentences.t: ወሖሩ ፡ ወአግበሩ ፡ ሊቃናተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ፸ ፡ ማዕጠንታተ ፡ በዘ ፡ የዐጥኑ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ወይሴብሑ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወነሥኡ ፡ እምአብያቲሆሙ ፡ ዕጣነ ፡ ወፍሕመ ፡ በማዕጠንት ፡ ወሖሩ ፡ ወቦኡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቅድስተ ፡ ቅዱሳን ፡ ከመ ፡ ይዕጠኑ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-went and-made chiefs-of Israel seventy censers with-which they-might-offer-incense to-Zion and-might-praise God, and-they-took from-houses-their incense and-coal in-censer, and-they-went and-entered into holy-of holies that they-might-offer-incense;
sentences.i: They went, and the chiefs of Israel made seventy censers with which to burn incense to Zion and praise God. They took incense from their houses, and coals, in the censer, and went and entered the Holy of Holies to offer the incense;
sentences.n: The Kebra Nagast moves the scene into the innermost shrine, where Numbers 16:17-18 has the censers brought to the tent's door. ወአግበሩ 'and they made' (causative-looking አግበረ is simply 'make' here); ሊቃናተ እስራኤል 'chiefs of Israel' (ሊቅ 'chief', plural ሊቃናት; the -ተ ending looks like an accusative though the chiefs seem to be the subject; 'seventy' may instead number the chiefs, so 'seventy of the chiefs made censers' is possible, ?). ማዕጠንታተ 'censers' (ማዕጠንት; plural also መዓጥንት). በዘ 'with which'; የዐጥኑ 'they might offer incense' (jussive of ዐጠነ), ወይሴብሑ 'and might praise' (ሴብሐ/ሰብሐ). ወፍሕመ 'and coal, ember' (ፍሕም). ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን 'holy of holies' (construct). ከመ ይዕጠኑ 'that they might burn incense'.

sentences.t: ወሶቤሃ ፡ ወደዩ ፡ ዕጣነ ፡ በአሐቲ ፡ ውዝዋዜ ፡ ማዕጠንት ፡ ወፅአ ፡ ነበልባል ፡ እመዓጥኒሆሙ ፡ ወውዕዩ ፡ ሶቤሃ ፡ ወተመስዉ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሠምዕ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ ገጸ ፡ እሳት ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ተመስዉ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሣዕር ፡ ይቡስ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይረክቦ ፡ ነበልባለ ፡ እሳት ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ውዕዩ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ንዋየ ፡ ቅድሳቲሆሙ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘተርፈ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ መዓጥኒሆሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-then they-put incense in-one swinging-of censer, and-came-out flame from-censers-their, and-they-burned then and-they-melted like wax before face-of fire; likewise they-melted like grass dry when it-meets flame-of fire; likewise they-burned with vessels-of holy-things-their; and-there-was-not that remained except censers-their;
sentences.i: At that moment they put the incense in, in a single swing of the censer, and a flame came out of their censers. They burned at once and melted like wax before the face of fire; they melted just as dry grass does when it meets a flame of fire; so they burned along with the vessels of their holy things, and nothing was left except their censers;
sentences.n: Compare Numbers 16:35 (fire from the Lord consumed the 250). ሶቤሃ 'then, at that moment'. ወደዩ 'they put' (ወደየ). ውዝዋዜ 'swinging, waving' (?), in construct with ማዕጠንት. ወፅአ 'came out'; እመዓጥኒሆሙ 'from their censers' (እም- + መዓጥንት + -ሆሙ). ውዕዩ is the 3mp perfect of ውዕየ 'burn' (intransitive); ተመስዉ 'they melted' (ተመስወ, ?). ሠምዕ 'wax'. በቅድመ ገጸ እሳት 'before the face of fire' (construct chain). ከመ ሣዕር ይቡስ 'like dry grass'. ይረክቦ 'it finds, meets' (the object ነበልባለ is accusative). ንዋየ 'vessels of' (construct of ንዋይ). ወአልቦ ዘተርፈ 'and there was nothing that remained' (አልቦ 'there is not').

sentences.t: ወይቤ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ቀድስዎን ፡ ሊተ ፡ ለእሉ ፡ መዓጥንት ፡ ለደብተራየ ፡ ወይኩን ፡ ለመሥዋዕትየ ፡ እስመ ፡ ተቀደሰ ፡ በሞተ ፡ ዚአሆሙ ፡ ማዕጠንትሰ ፡ ማርያም ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ወፍሕምኒ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ መለኮት ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወጼና ፡ ዕጣን ፡ መዐዛሁ ፡ ለክርስቶስ ፡ ዘበ ፡ መዐዛሁ ፡ ሐዋርያት ፡ ወነቢያት ፡ ወሰማዕታት ፡ ወፈላስያን ፡ መነኑ ፡ ዓለመ ፡ ወወረሱ ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ ሰማያት ፤
sentences.l: And-said God: Sanctify-them for-me, these censers, for-tent-my, and-let-it-be for-sacrifice-my, for it-was-sanctified by-death theirs. The-censer-indeed Mary she; and-the-coal-also Christ, son-of God, divinity he; and-scent-of incense, fragrance-his, of-Christ, in-whose fragrance apostles and-prophets and-martyrs and-ascetics they-renounced world and-inherited kingdom-of heavens;
sentences.i: And God said: 'Make these censers holy for me, for my tent, and let them be for my sacrifice, for it was made holy by their death.' The censer is Mary; the coal is Christ, the Son of God, who is divinity; and the scent of the incense, his fragrance, is Christ's, in whose fragrance apostles and prophets and martyrs and ascetics renounced the world and inherited the kingdom of heaven;
sentences.n: Compare Numbers 16:37-38 (the censers hallowed, hammered into a covering for the altar). ቀድስዎን is the 2mp imperative of ቀደሰ 'make holy' + ዎን 'them (f.)'; ሊተ 'for me'; ለደብተራየ 'for my tent' (ደብተራ). መሥዋዕት 'sacrifice' (or 'altar'). ተቀደሰ 'was made holy' (tä-stem passive); its subject is not stated (the tent, or the offering, ?), and the quotation of God probably runs into the narrator's exegesis at ማዕጠንትሰ. The allegory is the standard Ethiopian one: the censer is Mary, the coal Christ's divinity, the incense his fragrance (cf. ch. 96, where the same fire stands for divinity). -ሰ 'indeed', -ኒ 'also, and'. ጼና 'scent'. ዘበ መዐዛሁ 'in whose fragrance' (ዘ- + በ, ?). ሰማዕታት 'martyrs'; ፈላስያን 'pilgrims, hermits, ascetics'; መነኑ 'renounced' (መነነ, the monastic verb); መንግሥተ ሰማያት 'kingdom of the heavens' (constructs).

sentences.t: ወአሕባሊሃ ፡ ለመዓጥንት ፡ ሰዋስው ፡ ዘርእየ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ በዘ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ የዐርጉ ፡ ወይወርዲ ፡ ተእኂዞሙ ፡ ባቲ ፡ ወምስለ ፡ ጢሰ ፡ ዕጣን ፡ የዐርግ ፡ ዲበ ፡ መንበረ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ጸሎቶሙ ፡ ለንጹሓን ።
sentences.l: And-ropes-its, of-censers, ladder which-saw Jacob, by-which on-it they-ascend and-they-descend, holding-on-they to-it; and-with smoke-of incense goes-up upon throne-of God prayer-their of-the-pure.
sentences.i: And the cords of the censers are the ladder that Jacob saw, on which they go up and come down, holding fast to it; and with the smoke of the incense the prayers of the pure go up to the throne of God.
sentences.n: Allusion: Genesis 28:12 (Jacob's ladder), read as the chains of the censer. አሕባል 'cords, ropes' (plural of ሐብል) + ሃ 'its'; ሰዋስው 'ladder'; ዘርእየ 'which saw' (ዘ- + ርእየ). በዘ ቦቱ 'by which, on it' (a resumptive pronoun). የዐርጉ ወይወርዲ 'they go up and they come down' (ይወርዲ spells the 3mp ending with ዲ, perhaps for ይወርዱ, ?); ተእኂዞሙ is a verbal noun from ተአኀዘ 'hold on' + -ሙ, 'their holding on' (?). ጢሰ ዕጣን 'smoke of incense' (construct). ዲበ 'upon'. መንበረ 'throne of'. The verb የዐርግ is singular with ጸሎቶሙ ለንጹሓን 'their prayer(s), of the pure ones' (ለ- naming the owner after the suffix). Cf. Psalm 141:2 and Revelation 8:3-4 for incense as prayer.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ አውዐዮሙ ፡ ነበልባል ፡ ለኃጥኣን ፡ ሐመይዎሙ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ አዝማዲሆሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ኀልቁ ፡ ወይቤልዎሙ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወለአሮን ፡ አኅለቅምዎሙ ፡ ለነ ፡ ለሊቃውንቲነ ፡ ወነሥኡ ፡ እብነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይውግርዎሙ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወለአሮን ፤
sentences.l: And-when it-burned-them flame, the-sinners, they-grieved-over-them people kinsmen-their of-those who perished, and-they-said-to-them to-Moses and-to-Aaron: You-destroyed-them for-us, our-leaders! and-they-took stones that they-might-stone-them, Moses and-Aaron;
sentences.i: When the flame burned the sinners, the people, their kinsmen, grieved over those who had perished, and said to Moses and Aaron: 'You have destroyed them for us, our leaders!' And they took stones to stone Moses and Aaron;
sentences.n: Compare Numbers 16:41 (the next day all the congregation murmured: 'You have killed the people of the Lord'). አውዐዮሙ is the causative of ውዕየ 'burn' + 'them' (so 'it burned them'). ኃጥኣን 'sinners'. ሐመይዎሙ is from ሐመየ 'be pained, grieve' with a 'them' suffix, 'grieved over them' (?). አዝማዲሆሙ 'their kinsmen' (አዝማድ). ለእለ ኀልቁ 'of those who perished' (ኀልቀ 'come to an end'). ወይቤልዎሙ 'and they said to them' (the 'them' anticipates Moses and Aaron, named with ለ-). አኅለቅምዎሙ 'you destroyed them' (አኅለቀ, the 2mp 'you', honorific plural for two); ሊቃውንቲነ 'our leaders, teachers'. ከመ ይውግርዎሙ 'that they might stone them' (ወገረ).

sentences.t: ወተምዕዐ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ መዓተ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወአስቆረራ ፡ ከመ ፡ ፀርቀ ፡ ትክቶ ፡ ለምክረ ፡ ዳታን ፡ ወአቤሮን ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ቆሬ ፤
sentences.l: And-he-was-angry God, wrath, upon Israel, and-he-made-shudder-her, like outburst(?)-of vexation-his at-counsel-of Dathan and-Abiram, sons-of Korah;
sentences.i: And God was angered with wrath against Israel and made her shudder, in the measure of his vexation (?) at the counsel of Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Korah;
sentences.n: ወተምዕዐ 'and he was angry' (ተምዕዐ) with the cognate object መዓተ 'wrath'. ወአስቆረራ 'and he made her (Israel) shudder' (causative of ቆረረ, ?); I take it from 'be cold'. CRUX: ከመ ፀርቀ ትክቶ is obscure to me: ከመ 'like, as'; ትክቶ 'his weariness, vexation' (ትክት + ሁ); ፀርቀ I cannot place (an 'outburst, stroke'?), so the clause is a guess (?). ምክረ 'counsel of' (construct). Dathan and Abiram were Reubenites in Numbers 16:1, but this text, like many later writers, calls them 'sons of Korah' (ቆሬ, Korah) (the chapter's own wording).

sentences.t: ወቀጸባ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለምድር ፡ ወፈትሐት ፡ ምድር ፡ አፉሃ ፡ ወውኅጠቶሙ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘዚአሆሙ ፡ ወአን ፡ ስቲያሆሙ ፡ ወደቂቆሙ ፡ ወእንስሳሆሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-struck-her word-of God, the-earth, and-opened earth mouth-her, and-swallowed-them with all that-of-them, and-wives-their and-sons-their and-cattle-their;
sentences.i: The word of God struck the earth, and the earth opened her mouth and swallowed them with everything that was theirs, their wives and their sons and their cattle;
sentences.n: Compare Numbers 16:30-33. ወቀጸባ 'and (it) struck her' (ቀጸበ 'strike, beat' + 3fs); ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'word of God' (construct), with an accusative-looking ending though it seems to be the subject (?), and ለምድር naming the object. ፈትሐት 'she opened' (3fs perfect of ፈትሐ). ወውኅጠቶሙ 'and she swallowed them' (ውኅጠ). ምስለ 'with'; ዘዚአሆሙ 'that which is theirs'. ወአን ስቲያሆሙ: the printed word division looks wrong; I read ወአንስቲያሆሙ 'and their women, wives' (አንስት, ?). ወእንስሳሆሙ 'and their animals' (እንስሳ).

sentences.t: ወረዲ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሲኦል ፡ ሕያዋኒሆሙ ፡ ወተኀትመት ፡ ምድር ፡ በመልዕልቴሆሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-went-down into Sheol, living-ones-their, and-was-sealed earth above-them;
sentences.i: They went down alive into Sheol, and the earth was sealed over them;
sentences.n: Numbers 16:33 ('they went down alive into the pit'). ወረዲ spells the 3mp ending as ዲ, as in ይወርዲ above, so 'they went down' (ወረዱ, ?). ሲኦል 'Sheol, the underworld'. ሕያዋኒሆሙ 'their living ones, alive' (ሕያው pl. ሕያዋን, in apposition). ተኀትመት 'was sealed' (3fs passive of ኀተመ 'seal'). በመልዕልቴሆሙ 'above them' (በ- + መልዕልት 'top' + -ሆሙ).

sentences.t: ወለሕዝብሰ ፡ እለ ፡ ኀብሩ ፡ ምስሌሆሙ ፡ ሰሚዖሙ ፡ ሐሜተ ፡ ዚአሆሙ ፡ ፈነወ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ብድብደ ፡ ወሞቱ ፡ በአሐቲ ፡ ጊዜ ፤
sentences.l: And-as-for-the-people who they-joined with-them, having-heard slander theirs, he-sent to-them God plague, and-they-died in-one time;
sentences.i: As for the people who had joined them, God, hearing their slander, sent a plague upon them, and they died all at one time;
sentences.n: Compare Numbers 16:46-49 (the plague). ለሕዝብሰ: ለ- + -ሰ 'as for the people' (topic). እለ ኀብሩ 'who were joined' (ኀብረ). ሰሚዖሙ is a gerund of ሰምዐ + 'them', 'having heard them'; the subject, God, comes later. ሐሜት 'slander, murmuring'. ፈነወ 'he sent'. ብድብድ 'plague, pestilence'. በአሐቲ ጊዜ 'at one time, at once'.

sentences.t: ወቦኡ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወአሮን ፡ በዕጣን ፡ ወበማዕጠንት ፡ ወበከዩ ፡ በኀበ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወአስተስረዩ ፡ ለሕዝብ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብሉ ፡ ተዘከር ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አብርሃምሃ ፡ ፍቁርከ ፡ ወይስሐቅ ፡ ቊልዔከ ፡ ወእስራኤል ፡ ቅዱስከ ፡ እስመ ፡ ዘርኦሙ ፡ ንሕነ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ ሕዝብከ ፡ አቊርር ፡ መዐተከ ፡ እምኔነ ፡ ወፍጡነ ፡ ስምዐነ ፡ ወኢታማስነነ ፡ ወአእትት ፡ መቅሠፍተ ፡ እምላዕለ ፡ ሕዝብከ ፤
sentences.l: And-entered Moses and-Aaron with-incense and-with-censer, and-they-wept before God and-they-made-atonement for-the-people, while they-say: Remember, O-Lord, Abraham-indeed beloved-your, and-Isaac child-your, and-Israel holy-one-your; for seed-their we, children-of people-your. Quell wrath-your from-us, and-quickly hear-us, and-do-not-destroy-us, and-remove scourge from-upon people-your;
sentences.i: Moses and Aaron went in with incense and the censer, and wept before God and made atonement for the people, saying: 'Remember, O Lord, Abraham, your beloved, and Isaac, your child, and Israel, your holy one; for we are their seed, the children of your people. Quell your wrath against us, and hear us quickly, and do not destroy us, and take the scourge away from your people.'
sentences.n: Compare Numbers 16:46-48 (Aaron runs with the censer between the dead and the living) and the prayer of Exodus 32:13. ወበከዩ 'they wept' (በከየ); ወአስተስረዩ 'and they made atonement' (አስተሰረየ, the causative-reflexive stem of 'forgive'). ተዘከር 'remember' (imperative). እግዚኦ 'O Lord' (vocative). አብርሃምሃ: -ሃ is an emphasizing particle. ፍቁርከ 'your beloved' (ፍቁር with -ከ); ቊልዔከ 'your child' (ቊልዔ). ዘርኦሙ 'their seed'. አቊርር 'quell, cool' (imperative of አቊረረ, 'make cold'; cf. the verb at ወአስቆረራ above, ?). ስምዐነ 'hear us' (imperative + 'us'); ኢታማስነነ 'do not destroy us' (negative jussive of አማሰነ, ?). ወአእትት 'and remove' (imperative of አእተተ). መቅሠፍተ 'scourge' (መቅሠፍት). The long unit has no ፤ inside, so it is kept whole.

sentences.t: ወእግዚኣብሔር ፡ መሓሪ ፡ ርእየ ፡ የውሃቶ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወመሐሮሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-God merciful, seeing meekness-his of-Moses, and-he-had-mercy-on-them;
sentences.i: And God, who is merciful, seeing the meekness of Moses, took pity on them;
sentences.n: መሓሪ 'merciful' (participle of መሐረ 'have mercy'). ርእየ 'seeing' (gerund of ርእየ). CRUX: የውሃቶ ለሙሴ I read as 'his meekness, of Moses' (የዋህ 'gentle, meek' + ሁ, with ለ- naming the owner); compare Numbers 12:3 'the man Moses was very meek' (?). ወመሐሮሙ 'and he had mercy on them'.

sentences.t: ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ንግሮሙ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወበሎሙ ፡ ቀድሱ ፡ ርእሰክሙ ፡ ወአምጽኡ ፡ በበአብያተ ፡ አበዊክሙ ፡ በትረ ፤
sentences.l: And-he-spoke-to-him God to-Moses and-he-said-to-him: Tell-them, this people, and-say-to-them: Sanctify heads-your, and-bring by-houses-of fathers-your a-rod;
sentences.i: God spoke to Moses and said to him: 'Tell this people, and say to them: Make yourselves holy, and bring a rod from each of the houses of your fathers;
sentences.n: Numbers 17:1-2 (twelve rods, one from each tribal house). ነበቦ 'he spoke to him' (ነበበ + 'him'); ይቤሎ 'he said to him'. ንግሮሙ 'tell them' (imperative of ነገረ); ወበሎሙ 'and say to them' (imperative of ይቤ). ቀድሱ ርእሰክሙ 'sanctify yourselves' (ርእስ 'head' used for 'self'). ወአምጽኡ 'bring' (imperative of አምጽአ). በበአብያተ: በበ is distributive ('house by house'); አብያተ is the construct of ቤት 'house' (plural); አበዊክሙ 'your fathers'. በትረ 'a rod, staff' (accusative). The quotation continues through the next units.

sentences.t: ወጸሐፉ ፡ ከመ ፡ ታእምሩ ፡ በትሮሙ ፡ አንተ ፡ ወአሮን ፡ እኁከ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-wrote(?) that you-may-know rod-their, you and-Aaron brother-your;
sentences.i: and let them write, so that you may recognize their rod, you and Aaron your brother;
sentences.n: Numbers 17:2-3 (each name was written on a rod). ወጸሐፉ is the 3mp perfect 'and they wrote'; in the context of the command I read it as a jussive 'let them write' (?). ከመ ታእምሩ 'that you (pl.) may know' (አእመረ 'know, recognize'), which takes Moses and Aaron together as the subject. በትሮሙ 'their rod'. አንተ ወአሮን እኁከ 'you and Aaron your brother'.

sentences.t: ወእምቤትክሙሂ ፡ ይጽሐፍ ፡ አሮን ፡ በትሮ ፤
sentences.l: And-from-house-your-also let-write Aaron rod-his;
sentences.i: and from your house too, let Aaron write his rod;
sentences.n: ወእምቤትክሙሂ 'and from your house, too' (እም- 'from' + ቤት + -ክሙ 'your (pl.)' + -ሂ 'also'). ይጽሐፍ is the 3ms jussive of ጸሐፈ 'write', with Aaron as subject and በትሮ 'his rod' as object. Numbers 17:3 has Aaron's name on the Levi rod.

sentences.t: ወበትርከሰ ፡ ኢትጽሐፍ ፡ እስመ ፡ ፍጽምት ፡ ትእምርት ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ሕዝብከ ፡ ቅስት ፡ ለዐላውያን ፡ ወለኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ አምኑሰ ፡ ትእምርተ ፡ ሕይወት ፤
sentences.l: And-rod-your-indeed not-write, for perfect sign for-children-of people-your, bow(?) for-the-lawless and-for-all-of-them who believed-indeed sign-of life;
sentences.i: but your own rod you shall not write, for it is a perfect sign for the children of your people, a bow (?) against the lawless, and for all who believe, a sign of life;
sentences.n: ወበትርከሰ 'and your rod, indeed' (በትር + -ከ 'your' + -ሰ). ኢትጽሐፍ 'do not write' (negative jussive 2ms). ፍጽምት ትእምርት 'a perfect sign' (feminine adjective before its noun). CRUX: ቅስት is 'a bow', and I give it that way (?); it may stand for ቅሥት 'chastisement, scourge' (?), which would suit the rod's two edges, a threat to rebels and a sign of life to the faithful. ዐላውያን 'the lawless, rebels' (plural of ዐላዊ). ኵሎሙ 'all of them'; እለ አምኑ 'who believed' (አምነ), with -ሰ. ትእምርተ ሕይወት 'sign of life' (construct); compare Numbers 17:10, the rod laid up 'as a sign for rebels'.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ጸሐፍከ ፡ ይእ ፡ ዜ ፡ ምስሌሆሙ ፡ ይብሉከ ፡ ዛቲሰ ፡ እምትካት ፡ ገባሪተ ፡ መንክር ፡ በቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ እምይቤሉ ፡ ሶበ ፡ አርአይኩ ፡ ተኣምረ ፡ በውስቴታ ፤
sentences.l: And-when you-wrote now with-them they-will-say-to-you: This-one-indeed from-of-old(?) worker-of wonder by-word-of God, more-than they-said, when I-showed wonder in-her;
sentences.i: And when you have written it, then with them they will say to you: 'This rod, from of old (?), works wonders by the word of God', more than they said (?), when I show a wonder in it;
sentences.n: CRUX: the clause is obscure and I give it with several question marks. ይእ ዜ is the word ይእዜ 'now' printed divided. ይብሉከ 'they will say to you'. ዛቲሰ 'this one (f.), indeed' (the rod). እምትካት: I take it as 'from of old, at first' (?). ገባሪተ መንክር 'a worker of wonder' (feminine participle of ገብረ + መንክር 'wonder'). በቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'by the word of God'. እምይቤሉ: እም- may be comparative ('more than they said', ?). ሶበ አርአይኩ 'when I showed' (አርአየ, causative of ርእየ 'see'); ተኣምረ 'a wonder, miracle'; በውስቴታ 'in it (f.)' (በ- + ውስተ + -ኣ). Here God speaks in the first person ('I').

sentences.t: አላ ፡ ለቤተ ፡ አቡከ ፡ ጸሐፍ ፡ በትረ ፡ አሮን ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: But for-house-of father-your write rod-of Aaron. (marks)
sentences.i: But for the house of your father, write the rod of Aaron.
sentences.n: አላ 'but'. ለቤተ አቡከ 'for the house of your father' (ቤተ is the construct of ቤት; አቡከ 'your father'); the father's house is Levi's, and its rod is Aaron's (Numbers 17:3). ጸሐፍ 'write' (imperative). በትረ አሮን 'rod of Aaron' (construct). The seven ፨ at the end are the printed closing marks of the chapter, as at the end of ch. 96.
